children: Dillard's, Inc. reported results for 2026 with revenue roughly flat year over year and notable gains in profitability: net income rose to $97.69M and diluted EPS increased to $6.25, driven by improved retail gross margin and positive mix effects.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per share”.
Retail net sales rose about 1% in Q2 and about 2% year-to-date, supported by comparable store sales growth.
In-store and online channels remained interdependent; average ticket increased 7% while transactions declined 5–6%.
Strong category performance in ladies’ accessories/lingerie and home/furniture; modest gains in men’s apparel and shoes.
Opened a new 160,000 sq ft store at The Mall at Fairfield Commons during the first half of 2026.
Retail gross margin improved materially, aided by tariff refunds and targeted cost and pricing actions.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
